findings.description: In enrich_one, the retry branch is `return enrich(event, geo)` without await. enrich is async, so the function returns a coroutine object. _flush then passes that coroutine to sink as if it were an Event, so to_json fails or writes garbage. Any lookup that times out once breaks the run.
findings.suggestion: Change the line to `return await enrich(event, geo)`.
findings.title: Retry returns an un-awaited coroutine instead of an Event

findings.description: `total = sum(1 for _ in lines)` exhausts `lines`. When lines is a file object or other one-shot iterator (as cli.py passes), the later `for line in lines` loop sees no items. The run reads zero lines, writes nothing, and reports zero counts, so the output file is empty.
findings.suggestion: Materialise the input first, for example `lines = list(lines)`, which costs memory on large exports. Or drop the up-front total and report progress against an unknown total.
findings.title: Counting lines consumes the input iterator, so nothing is processed
